_comment: Performance baselines for the perf-regression gate in .github/workflows/perf.yml. Each key is `<bench_name>_<unit>`; the value is the median from a measurement run. The CI gate fails if any tracked bench regresses >10% vs these numbers. Both baselines are calibrated for GHA ubuntu-latest shared runners: search_warm_p95 measured 1.174ms there, and merge_10kb_clean measured about 36us. To update after an intentional perf change: run `cargo bench --bench <name>`, paste the new median here, and document the change in the PR description.
